headline: DISCOVERY MINING DOME EXTENDS 600M SOUTH — 3.41 g/t Over 17m AND Bonanza 2,310 g/t Core; 11 Moz Timmins Resource Update Q1 2027
snippet: Discovery Mining (TSX: DSV) released 36 holes totaling 16,365 metres at its Dome Mine project near Timmins, Ontario, extending the 11 million ounce Inferred open-pit resource 600 metres south of the existing resource pit. Standout results include DOM26-046 at 3.41 g/t over 17.3 metres (plus 1.42 g/t over 17.0 m in the same hole) and DOM26-048's uncut bonanza intercept of 2,310 g/t gold over 1.0 metre — confirming high-grade pods within the bulk-tonnage system. A resource estimate update incorporating all 2026 drilling is targeted for Q1 2027.

headline: MANHATTAN GOLD JAWS BITES: 41.15m AT 4.66 G/T IN NUNAVUT — First Modern Drilling in 30 Years Extends Historic System to 1,252m Strike
snippet: Manhattan Gold (ASX: MHC) released assays from its maiden 2026 drill program at Hook Lake in Nunavut, with hole JWS26006b returning 41.15 metres at 4.66 g/t gold from 83.82 metres depth — spot values reaching 41 g/t — the first modern drilling at the project in over 30 years. Follow-up hole JWS26012 extended the Jaws zone to a 1,252-metre strike length, well beyond the historical resource footprint of 285,000 ounces at 2.38 g/t; five assays remain pending including a test below all prior historic drilling, keeping the discovery open at depth.

headline: NEWMONT REPORTS Q3 TOMORROW: $1.96 EPS EXPECTED, AISC RISING TOWARD $1,961/OZ — Oil Costs Test Gold Margins Ahead of Biggest Producer Report
snippet: Newmont Corporation (NYSE: NEM) reports Q3 2026 results after the close October 22, with analysts projecting adjusted EPS of $1.96 and revenue of approximately $6.01 billion; higher realized gold prices near $4,100 provide a tailwind, but gold production is expected flat at roughly 1.3 million attributable ounces while AISC is forecast to rise sequentially to approximately $1,961 per ounce — driven by higher sustaining capital and elevated oil costs. With Q4 guided as the strongest quarter and full-year guidance anchored at 5.26 million ounces, management's cost outlook will be the key watchpoint for junior mining investors tracking major-miner cost benchmarks.

headline: BARRICK GOLD Q3 PRODUCTION SEQUENTIALLY RISES TO 943,000 OZ — Copper at 48,000T; Financial Results and Updated Guidance Due November 2
snippet: Barrick Gold (TSX/NYSE: ABX) released preliminary Q3 2026 production figures showing gold output of approximately 943,000 ounces — a sequential increase from Q2's 796,000 ounces — alongside copper production of 48,000 tonnes, with all-in sustaining costs of approximately $1,507 per ounce. The Q3 recovery was supported by the Loulo-Gounkoto restart in Mali and higher grades at Nevada Gold Mines; full financial results and updated full-year guidance are scheduled for November 2. The AISC figure, if confirmed, runs well inside guidance and would represent a meaningful margin expansion at current gold prices.

headline: AGNICO EAGLE UP 1.28% AS MARKET FRONT-RUNS Q3 BEAT — October 28 Report to Confirm H2 Production Ramp at Detour Lake, Meliadine
snippet: Agnico Eagle Mines (TSX/NYSE: AEM) gained 1.28% on October 21 as investors positioned ahead of Q3 2026 results due October 28 after normal trading hours — a divergence from gold's fourth straight down session that signals earnings-driven demand. Management has guided that gold production is weighted to a stronger second half versus Q1's 825,109 payable ounces; analysts are focused on whether AISC tracks below the full-year guidance band as higher-grade mill feed at Detour Lake, Meliadine, and Hope Bay drives the sequential improvement. AEM's earnings release sets up a one-two punch with Newmont October 22 that will define gold sector sentiment heading into the FOMC.

headline: PC GOLD SPRING HILL HITS 33m AT 2.23 G/T — December Resource Update Near as Open-Pit Model Approaches 1 Moz
snippet: PC Gold (ASX: PC2) released new drill results from its Spring Hill gold project showing 33 metres at 2.23 g/t gold and 28 metres at 2.52 g/t, adding to a growing drill database ahead of an updated Mineral Resource Estimate targeted for December 2026. The consistent shallow, wide intercepts continue to support open-pit mining economics at a project building toward a pre-feasibility study; the company's current combined resource sits near one million ounces, and the December estimate is expected to be materially larger following the 2026 infill and extension program.

headline: FALCON METALS ERRABIDDY FIRST ASSAY: 12m AT 2.8 G/T AU FROM SURFACE — 30 WA Gold Holes Still Pending in Funded Maiden Program
snippet: Falcon Metals, farm-in partner to West Coast Silver (ASX: WCE), reported the first gold assay from its maiden 6,000-metre RC drilling program at the Errabiddy gold project in Western Australia: 12 metres at 2.8 g/t gold from surface. The program targets a 5.8-kilometre soil anomaly with 50 holes planned across a central 2.5-kilometre zone; with approximately 30 holes still awaiting assays, the surface intercept establishes the anomaly has genuine grade — and a Western Australian government grant covering 50% of up to $180,000 in drilling costs means shareholders carry a substantially de-risked discovery program.

headline: EMPEROR METALS DUQUESNE WEST: 51 OF 66 HOLES REPORTED, Q4 RESTART PLANNED — Quebec High-Grade System Builds Toward PEA
snippet: Emperor Metals (TSX-V: EMAUF) continued releasing 2026 assays from its Duquesne West gold project in Quebec, with 51 of 66 holes now reported across 13,943 metres; highlights from the 2026 program include 32 metres at 5.9 g/t Au, 20.1 metres at 5.0 g/t Au, and earlier 15 metres at 61.5 g/t Au, confirming both bulk-tonnage near-surface potential and deeper high-grade veins. The company has completed the initial campaign on budget and plans to resume drilling in Q4 2026, advancing toward a preliminary economic assessment with 50% partner Globex Mining; 15 hole assays and the full historical core resampling dataset remain pending.

headline: LINQ MINERALS GILMORE FIRST HOLE HITS 429m VISIBLE GOLD-COPPER MINERALISATION — NSW System Assays Due 6-8 Weeks
snippet: LinQ Minerals (ASX: LNQ) reported visible gold-copper mineralisation across 429 metres in the first drill hole at Gidginbung South within its Gilmore gold-copper project in New South Wales, a length the company describes as indicative of a large-scale mineral system. Assays are expected in six to eight weeks; if the visuals convert to grade across even a fraction of that length, Gilmore — in a historically productive NSW gold belt with the $75 million-capped explorer holding a large land package — could become one of the year's more significant Australian copper-gold exploration results.

headline: ROYAL ROAD MINERALS ADVANCES EL ALEMAN TARGET IN COLOMBIA — New GAM Drill Targets Defined Ahead of Next Program
snippet: Royal Road Minerals (TSX-V: RYR) advanced exploration targeting at the El Alemán zone of its GAM project in Colombia, following 2026 drilling that defined a bulk-tonnage porphyry-skarn system extending from surface to more than 450 metres vertical depth with gold-equivalent grades in a 50/50 alliance with Colombia's largest miner Mineros S.A. New surface mapping and sampling data has refined the next round of drill targets at El Aleman and adjacent GAM zones — a key step ahead of what the company expects will be a larger-scale drill program to expand the system already demonstrating porphyry copper-gold scale potential.
